description:
Using the Electrical Engineering Calculations app, navigate to the Op-Amp (Operational Amplifier) calculator and select the 'Non-Inverting Amplifier' configuration. Calculate the output voltage and gain for the following parameters:
- Input Voltage (Vin): 0.5 V
- Feedback Resistor (Rf): 9000 Ohms
- Input/Ground Resistor (R1/Rg): 1000 Ohms

After calculating:
1. Take a screenshot of the result screen and save it to '/sdcard/tasks/op_amp_result.png'.
2. Create a text file at '/sdcard/tasks/op_amp_results.txt' containing the calculated values in this format:
Gain: <value>
Vout: <value> V
